scope: Deductive checking of the extracted production allocateIdentity function under owned-counter contracts. Private-state ownership, engine callers and browser effects require separate verification.

contracts.available: Owned writable next field, arbitrary record prototype, integral counter in 1..9007199254740991; returns old counter, advances next exactly once, preserves prototype and framed heap.
contracts.exhausted: Owned writable next field equal 9007199254740992; returns undefined, leaves counter/prototype and framed heap unchanged.

callerCorrespondence: pending: establish initialization, private ownership, integral range preservation and use by every identity allocator

numericModel.integerPrecondition: Gillian is-int predicate with explicit bounded numeric conditions
numericModel.arithmetic: Mathematical-number arithmetic; this is not an IEEE-754 bit-level proof.
numericModel.requiredJavaScriptContract: Integers 1..9007199254740992 are exactly representable; adding 1 to an integer at most 9007199254740991 is exact. These properties of trusted JavaScript arithmetic connect bounded integral states to the model.

referenceSource.correspondence: Reference source shows real-valued Num arithmetic; the pinned container source revision remains unidentified.

extraction.changes: Remove export and type annotations; TypeScript emits ES5 variable declarations. No allocation-body substitution in the production cases.
extraction.closedBody: Reject top-level runtime dependencies, compiler helpers and free runtime identifiers.
